issue.title: Move $ hook reset and accept-then-mail into durable patch settlement
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/sync.py`, `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/_base_patch.py`, `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/proposal_rebase.py`; `reset_dollar_hooks` is never called from CLI `sase patch sync` or from durable patch settlement.

`$` hook reset after TUI sync, reword, and add-tag, and the accept-then-mail chain, run only from in-memory `ProcCallbackConfig.on_complete` handlers. Those callbacks are dropped when the user quits, the TUI crashes mid-operation, or the operation outlives the 60-second update-restart deadline. Repo search on 2026-10-04 found every `reset_dollar_hooks` caller in those TUI callbacks; sase-core has no matching settlement. CLI `sase patch sync` therefore also leaves `$` hooks with stale verdicts after content changes.

This is a domain settlement fix. It may belong in `sase-core` so CLI, TUI, and crash recovery share one path. Do not fold it into the TUI restart-callback wait.

## Repro

1. Start ACE, run Patch sync / reword / add-tag (or accept with mark-ready-to-mail) so a durable proc is in flight.
2. Quit ACE, crash it, or wait out a 60-second update restart while the proc is still running.
3. After the durable operation finishes, `$` hooks still hold pre-change verdicts. Accept-then-mail never runs.
4. Independently: `sase patch sync` from the CLI never calls `reset_dollar_hooks` even on success.

## Impact

Stale `$` hook verdicts after patch content has changed. Accept-with-mail never chains `action_mail()` unless the originating TUI stays alive through completion.
